_meta.purpose: Operational definition of each workflow task: what it is for, who does it, which tracked documents it needs, and what blocks it. Held as data so a task briefing can be computed rather than generated.
_meta.why_this_exists: A task was a bare string. build_workflow() returned ["Initial case review", "Collect identity documents", ...] and nothing else existed - no purpose, no required documents, no owner. The AI button therefore sent the model one line of text with no case attached, and the model produced a general article about Swiss immigration, because a task title is the only thing it had. The article was the symptom; the missing data model was the cause.

what_is_and_is_not_claimed.purpose: Operational description of the step. Not a legal statement.
what_is_and_is_not_claimed.owner: Who performs the step in a relocation mandate. A working convention, not a legal allocation of responsibility.
what_is_and_is_not_claimed.required_documents: Canonical document names as used by core/documents/analyzer.py. Only names that appear there can be checked, so only those are listed - a requirement the product cannot verify is worse than an absent one, because it looks verified.
what_is_and_is_not_claimed.duration: Deliberately absent. No Swiss authority publishes per-step durations, and inventing one would let a consultant promise a date on the strength of a number this product made up. Target durations are a per-customer SLA and belong in tenant settings, not here.

_meta.owner_note: A fixed set rather than free text, so tasks can later be routed to a real user by role. CANTONAL_AUTHORITY and COMMUNE mean the case is waiting on an authority: nobody on the customer's side can advance it, which is a materially different state from 'not started' and is shown as such.

initial_case_review.title: Initial case review
initial_case_review.purpose: Confirm the case has the facts needed to enter the workflow: who the employee is, which permit path applies, and which employer is sponsoring.

collect_identity_documents.title: Collect identity documents
collect_identity_documents.purpose: Obtain the identity evidence every downstream authority step depends on. Nothing can be submitted without it.

verify_employment_contract.title: Verify employment contract
verify_employment_contract.purpose: Check that a signed contract exists and that its start date is consistent with the permit timeline, since work may not begin before an authorisation exists (Art. 11 AIG).

validate_visa_eligibility.title: Validate visa eligibility
validate_visa_eligibility.purpose: Establish which entry route applies to this third-country national before an application is prepared.

check_immigration_quota.title: Check immigration quota
check_immigration_quota.purpose: Confirm quota availability for this permit type before committing to a start date. Non-EU/EFTA cases are quota-subject and a start date agreed without this is a date that can be missed.

prepare_entry_authorization.title: Prepare entry authorization
prepare_entry_authorization.purpose: Assemble the entry authorisation file for submission to the cantonal authority.

process_eu_registration.title: Process EU registration
process_eu_registration.purpose: Handle the registration route that applies to EU/EFTA nationals, which is a declaration rather than a quota-subject authorisation.

prepare_permit_application.title: Prepare permit application
prepare_permit_application.purpose: Compile the residence permit application for a case that has no valid permit yet.

collect_biometric_data.title: Collect biometric data
collect_biometric_data.purpose: Have the employee attend biometric capture, which the authority requires before a permit card is produced.

schedule_cantonal_appointment.title: Schedule cantonal appointment
schedule_cantonal_appointment.purpose: Book the cantonal appointment and align it with the contract start date.

validate_existing_permit.title: Validate existing permit
validate_existing_permit.purpose: Confirm the permit already held is valid, covers this employer, and does not expire inside the mandate.

employer_eligibility_verification.title: Employer eligibility verification
employer_eligibility_verification.purpose: Verify the employer may sponsor this permit type.

validate_permanent_residence.title: Validate permanent residence
validate_permanent_residence.purpose: Confirm the settlement permit is current. A C permit needs the least intervention of any status, so this step is a check rather than a process.

cross_border_worker_verification.title: Cross-border worker verification
cross_border_worker_verification.purpose: Establish the cross-border arrangement: where the employee resides, where they work, and how often they return.

tax_registration.title: Tax registration
tax_registration.purpose: Register the employee for withholding tax, which for a cross-border worker involves a second jurisdiction.

social_insurance_registration.title: Social insurance registration
social_insurance_registration.purpose: Register the employee for social insurance under the arrangement that applies to their status.

commune_registration_valais.title: Commune registration (Valais)
commune_registration_valais.purpose: Register the employee at their commune of residence. Registration is an obligation under Art. 12 AIG and the deadline is counted from arrival, so this step is time-critical rather than administrative.
commune_registration_valais.note: The deadline differs by commune - see data/canton_valais_communes.json. It cannot be derived from the canton, so a case with no commune recorded has no computable deadline and says so.

cantonal_approval.title: Cantonal approval
cantonal_approval.purpose: The cantonal authority (SPM) reviews the file. Nothing on the customer's side advances this step.

housing_registration.title: Housing registration
housing_registration.purpose: Record the residential address, which commune registration and correspondence both depend on.

family_relocation_support.title: Family relocation support
family_relocation_support.purpose: Coordinate accompanying family members. Whether any exist is not recorded on the case, so this step is listed without a document requirement rather than assuming a family.

employer_sponsorship_verification.title: Employer sponsorship verification
employer_sponsorship_verification.purpose: Confirm the sponsoring employer's undertaking for a recruitment mandate, where the start date is usually fixed before the authorisation exists.

sme_compliance_review.title: SME compliance review
sme_compliance_review.purpose: Walk a smaller employer with no in-house mobility function through their obligations for this case.

close_relocation_case.title: Close relocation case
close_relocation_case.purpose: Confirm every obligation is discharged and the file is complete before the mandate is closed.
